I am an MSc student in **Biostatistics at the University of Zurich**, with a BSc in **Mathematics from Aristotle University of Thessaloniki**.

My background combines mathematics, statistical computing, and applications in health and life sciences. My undergraduate project used **Markov chain theory and R** to study patterns of cancer metastasis.
